description: This file defines common UI widgets and utilities for a Flutter app, including customizable buttons, card headers with gradients, various loading/error/empty states, and a snack bar helper.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: A themed primary button widget with optional icon and loading indicator.

classes.name: SecondaryButton
classes.description: A themed secondary outline button with optional icon.

classes.name: GradientHeaderCard
classes.description: A card widget with a gradient header, title, optional subtitle, leading icon, and content area.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: A widget showing a loading spinner with a message.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget displaying an empty state with icon, title, and message.

classes.name: ErrorState
classes.description: A widget displaying an error state with optional retry button.

methods.name: showAppSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a themed snackbar with optional action.

methods.name: isMockMode
methods.description: Checks whether the app is in mock mode based on Env.mockMode.
